reasoning: The icon clearly depicts an upright battery at roughly 80-90% charge, making it a strong visual cue for tasks about buying, charging, replacing, or recycling batteries and power banks. Because it is one of several incremental battery-level status icons, it is slightly less distinct than a full battery or a battery with a lightning bolt, and at tiny sizes its white top cutout can briefly resemble a labeled bottle.
